messages:
alex: Heads-up: customer report that fncall schema rejects are being attributed to /chat.generate in the console and quota panels. Small counts but customer-facing.

priya: can you drop an example req id?

alex: req 3f7b9c20 at 2025-11-12T11:03:12Z. server returned error invalid_function_output and console shows /chat.generate.

sam: quick theory: after the streaming refactor route-resolution moved after validation, so early validation errors get default route.

priya: if that's true the fix is either move route-resolve earlier or persist a route-hint header at ingress for validator to read. moving earlier is risky for streaming path.

alex: ops flagged for chargeback risk on dedicated customers. we should be conservative.

ops-bot: dry-run: predicate "validation.error_kind:invalid_function_output AND billing.route:'/chat.generate'" between 2025-11-11T00:00 and 2025-11-12T12:00 => 196 matches. CSV export ready on request.

sam: thanks bot. My preference: add x-route-hint at auth/ingress stage (populated from route table), have validator prefer header when emitting billing/telemetry. low-risk, reversible.

priya: agree. also add a short-term shim: if validator emits invalid_function_output and header absent, set billing.route to /fncall before emitting billing event. Gate both changes behind ff preserve-route-before-validate.

alex: timeline?

sam: i'll open PR today with header injection + validator fallback + unit/e2e. will include telemetry change to include route_hint in validation payload.

billing: once you have PR i'll need a mapping of impacted reqs by customer to reconcile chargeback. ops to coordinate.

ops-bot: acknowledged. will run patch-dry-run after canary and provide CSV for billing. Note: any server change must be canaried 10% hosted/dedicated.

priya: tests: add integration that simulates a fncall function output mismatch and asserts billing.route == /fncall when header is set, and also asserts shim behavior when header missing behind ff.

sam: also adding a short-lived dashboard alert to detect >3 mislabels/hour in the canary window so support teams can react.

alex: perfect. once PR merges i'll post a support note and add a temporary KB entry explaining reconciliation plan.

ops-bot: after canary stable, run backfill script to remap historical events where predicate matched; will coordinate with @billing before any billing writes.

priya: small follow-up: include logs snippet in PR showing original validator error and resulting billing event for audit.

sam: will do. PR target EOD.

alex: thanks everyone.
